projects.title: Four-bit absolute comparator
projects.description: Designed and optimized a four-bit absolute comparator, from Boolean logic to circuit-level performance. Verified functionality in MATLAB and explored the trade-off between energy consumption and delay.
details: Designed and integrated absolute-value and comparator logic using truth tables, Karnaugh maps, and De Morgan's laws; verified circuit functionality through MATLAB simulation.
Adjusted gate sizes and supply voltage along the critical path to evaluate the energy-delay tradeoff.
Reduced energy consumption by 48.13% at 1.5 times the baseline delay while maintaining circuit functionality.

publications.title: Fabrication and Optimization of a Four-Bit Absolute Comparator
publications.venue: 2024 International Conference on Computers, Information Processing and Advanced Education (CIPAE)
publications.summary: Designed the comparator logic and verified its functionality in MATLAB. Optimized gate sizing and supply voltage to reduce energy consumption by 48.13% at 1.5 times the baseline delay.

bullets: Assisted with circuit board soldering, testing, troubleshooting, and repair for charging stations.
Supported installation and testing of a home backup energy storage system; implemented multithreading and algorithm optimizations to improve performance.
Contributed to a battery pack module upgrade to address overheating in charging stations; conducted testing and data analysis to support product efficiency and reliability.
